---
title: "Cell type atlas"
output: html_notebook
---

# Load dependencies
```{r message=FALSE}
library(scater)
source("../lib_sce.R")
```


# Load object containg Cell type atlas
```{r}
e10x <- loadHDF5SingleCellExperiment("out/mouse_ctx_10x.h5")
#essv4 <- loadHDF5SingleCellExperiment("out/mouse_ctx_ssv4.h5")
```


# Display UMAP collored by cell type
```{r}
ggcells(e10x[,sample(ncol(e10x),50000)]) + 
  geom_point(aes(x=UMAP.1,y=UMAP.2,color=subclass_color),size=1) + 
  coord_equal() + 
  scale_color_identity() +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position="none")
```

# Example gene expression
```{r}
ggcells(e10x[,sample(ncol(e10x),50000)],features = "Gad1",exprs_values = "counts") + 
  geom_point(aes(x=UMAP.1,y=UMAP.2,color=Gad1>0),size=1) + 
  coord_equal() + 
  theme_classic()
```
